from: A 2024 survey by ResumeGo found that candidates who submitted cover letters received interview invitations 53% more often than those who did not. However, generic cover letters performed no better than no letter at all.
to: In a ResumeGo field experiment (7,287 applications sent between July 2019 and January 2020), applications with a cover letter tailored to the job got a 16.4% callback rate, against 10.7% with no cover letter, about 53% more. A generic letter landed in between, at 12.5%.
